method.name: Euler--Maclaurin with separately integrated finite Bernoulli remainder

zeroPoleRules.rule: The multiplier is finite and nonzero; nontrivial zero multiplicities agree.
Simple trivial zeta zeros cancel simple Gamma(s/2) poles; they are not xi zeros.
The simple zeta pole is removed by s-1; xi(1)=1/2.
The factor s removes the Gamma(s/2) pole; xi(0)=1/2.

primarySources.use: Euler--Maclaurin continuation; the even-Bernoulli remainder follows by integration by parts.
Outward real/imaginary enclosures for the finite arithmetic and elementary powers.
